name: @afd/example-todo
description: Multi-stack Todo example with AFD patterns

scripts.test:conformance:ts: pnpm --dir backends/typescript build && tsx dx/run-conformance.ts --backend ts
scripts.test:conformance:rs: cargo build --locked --manifest-path backends/rust/Cargo.toml && tsx dx/run-conformance.ts --backend rs
scripts.test:conformance:umbel: (cd ../../../endpoints/umbel && cargo build --locked -p umbel-plugin-todo --bin umbel-todo) && tsx dx/run-conformance.ts --backend umbel
scripts.test:conformance:umbel-mounted: (cd ../../../endpoints/umbel && cargo build --locked -p umbel --bin umbel) && cargo build --locked --manifest-path backends/rust/Cargo.toml && tsx dx/run-conformance.ts --backend umbel-mounted
scripts.test:conformance:cpp: cmake -S backends/cpp -B backends/cpp/build/release -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DAFD_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=ON && cmake --build backends/cpp/build/release --target todo-server-cpp && tsx dx/run-conformance.ts --backend cpp
